finePrint.summary: For AppSumo buyers, the deal page defines plan limits while these Terms still govern use.

quote.text: If you bought AdaptlyPost through AppSumo, the plan and limits shown on the AppSumo deal page apply to your account.

finePrint.summary: EU consumers get a 14-day withdrawal right on the initial subscription purchase only.

quote.text: Right of Withdrawal for Subscriptions: As an EU consumer, you have the right to withdraw from your subscription within 14 days of your initial purchase, without giving any reason

finePrint.summary: Renewals are excluded from withdrawal because continued use counts as acceptance.

quote.text: The 14-day withdrawal period applies only to your initial subscription purchase. Subscription renewals are not eligible for withdrawal, as continued use of the Service after the renewal date constitutes acceptance

finePrint.summary: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 14 business days.

quote.text: Approved refunds will be processed within 14 business days and returned to your original payment method

finePrint.summary: Vendor can change prices with 30 days notice to existing subscribers.

quote.text: We might change our prices, but we'll give existing subscribers 30 days' notice

finePrint.summary: Vendor can update Terms by posting a new version, with continued use meaning acceptance.

quote.text: We can update these Terms. When we do, we'll post the new version and update the date at the top.

finePrint.summary: Continuing to use the service after changes means you accept the new Terms.

quote.text: If you keep using the Service after we make changes, that means you accept them.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can suspend or close accounts for Terms violations, fraud, or other reasons it deems necessary.

quote.text: We can suspend or close your account if you break these Terms, do something fraudulent, or for other reasons we deem necessary.

finePrint.summary: Non-payment can trigger suspension or closure of the account.

quote.text: We can suspend or close your account if payments aren't made

finePrint.summary: Repeat copyright infringers face account termination.

quote.text: We terminate the accounts of repeat infringers in appropriate circumstances.

finePrint.summary: All plans use AI credits where each AI operation consumes credits.

finePrint.summary: Consumed AI credits are treated as fully performed and are not refundable.

trials.claim: Includes all future Creator, Pro, or Enterprise plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Creator (Tier 1), Pro (Tier 2), or Enterprise (Tiers 3-5) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say AppSumo buyers are held to the plan and limits shown on the deal page, which materially limits the promise of all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: If you bought AdaptlyPost through AppSumo, the plan and limits shown on the AppSumo deal page apply to your account.
exhibits.argument: Future updates are capped to the limits shown on the deal page rather than all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: We can suspend or close your account if you break these Terms, do something fraudulent, or for other reasons we deem necessary.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves broad discretion to suspend or close accounts, allowing promised future access to be taken back.

trials.claim: Supports publishing to 13 social platforms with AI captions, images and automation
trials.claimQuote: Plan, schedule, and publish to 13 social platforms with AI-powered captions, images, and automation
trials.reasoning: The vendor states it publishes to all 13 supported platforms in one dashboard and its AI copilot writes and rewrites captions per platform. The single reviews about X links and link credits do not show the 13 platforms or AI captions are unavailable.

exhibits.quote: However, a big letdown for me was the inability to use links in my X posts, which worked.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports publishing to X fails when posts contain links, undermining 13-platform publishing claim.

exhibits.quote: I was a little bit disapoinnted about how many credits a link cost to post.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports posting links costs extra credits, undermining included automation value.

exhibits.quote: AdaptlyPost plans, schedules, and publishes to all 13 supported platforms, from Instagram and TikTok to LinkedIn and Bluesky, in one dashboard.
exhibits.argument: This quote confirms the vendor claims publishing to all 13 supported platforms from one dashboard.

exhibits.quote: The AdaptlyPost AI copilot writes captions, rewrites them per platform, and adds hashtags from a single prompt.
exhibits.argument: This quote confirms the vendor offers AI-powered captions tailored per platform.

trials.claim: Can map out weeks or months of content in one visual calendar
trials.claimQuote: Map out weeks or months of social content in one visual calendar so you always know what's going live
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes a calendar showing drafts, scheduled, and published posts by day, and a buyer confirms scheduling weeks or months in advance.

exhibits.quote: The AdaptlyPost calendar shows every draft, scheduled, and published post by day, so your posting slots stay filled.
exhibits.argument: This quote confirms the vendor provides a visual calendar showing all posts by day.

exhibits.quote: This way I can schedule weeks (months!) in advance and not worry about running out before they refresh for the next month.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms they can schedule weeks or months in advance using the platform.

trials.claim: Automatically schedules posts at optimal times based on audience
trials.claimQuote: Automatically schedule posts at optimal times based on your audience, ensuring your content lands when engagement is highest
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes scheduling X posts at times you pick yourself, which conflicts with automatic scheduling at optimal times based on your audience.

exhibits.quote: Schedule tweets and threads for X at the times you pick.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes manual time selection by the user, not automatic optimal-time scheduling based on audience.
